claims.statement: The required check Aggregate Test Results does not close over action_tests: it is neither in the gate's needs nor inspected via a result reference.
2268 of 11340 valid topological orderings place the gate before action_tests.
action_tests is intended to block a merge when it fails.
claims.settled_by: A statement of intent from the repository owners, or the job being made a required context in branch protection.

envelope.declared: Static analysis of the declared job-ID dependency graph in one workflow file, plus the required-check list observed via the GitHub checks API.
out_of_scope: Runtime scheduling frequency on GitHub runners
Job durations, runner availability and concurrency limits
Behaviour of reusable workflows not declared in this file
Whether any excluded job ought to block a merge, which is repository policy

assumptions.statement: The required-check list observed on a recent merged pull request reflects current branch protection.
assumptions.how_to_verify: Compare against your repository settings, or re-query the checks API with isRequired on an open pull request.

provenance.method: Arcifact Gate closure analysis with exact ideal enumeration

payload.remediation: Add action_tests to report_test_success.needs and inspect needs.action_tests.result, allowing skipped.
